raw.commentary: Layer is strongest on Becoming Neo and Neo and Trinity arcs with clear causal chains and distinct stances, but Morpheus's Faith breaks causal integrity, perspective discipline and membership by importing Neo-centric events and missing its own payoff, and the heavy reuse of ev-010/ev-032/ev-034/ev-044 across three plots is mostly justified by different dilemmas except for the Morpheus/Neo duplication at ev-039.
